landing.title: Every role knows its schedule, its menu, its rules and its duties.
landing.body: The staff operating system of The First Hospitality Group. The schedule with confirmations, the menu with photos, house rules, side work and the close, with every instruction going through the chain of supervision.
landing.installed: Already installed? Open it from your home screen.
landing.point1: Your schedule, confirmed when it is published
landing.point2: Every dish, drink and wine with photo and allergens
landing.point3: Instructions down the chain, reports up, never in group chats
landing.staffOnly: For The First team only. Ask your manager for an account.

recover.title: Recover access
recover.body: Managers and owners: we send a 6-digit code to your verified email.
recover.sent: If the email has an account, the code is on its way. It expires in 10 minutes.

legal.termsBody: The First is an internal tool of The First Hospitality Group for its staff. Use it for work only. Do not share your password. Do not take photos of guests. What you record (tasks, counts, notes, requests) is part of the venue's operating record.
legal.privacyBody: We keep your name, username, optional email, language and display preferences, the devices that receive notifications, and your work records: task completions, counts, warnings with your responses, requests. Training requests, supervisor observations and program versions are also recorded. We do not keep your date of birth, ID numbers, home address or phone number. Warnings count for 30 days and are kept as employment records. You can see everything stored about your warnings on your Me screen. Ask your manager or the owner for a copy or a correction.
legal.updated: Last updated October 2026. To be reviewed by counsel before go-live.
